Result that strengthens model: Calibration segment fits and validation residual is treated as model-form uncertainty

Result that weakens model: kH, chi_s, lambda_e dominate decision without external bounds
Result that strengthens model: Dominant variables are measured/literature-bounded or thresholds are reported

Result that strengthens model: M3 identifies time/path effects or different over-credit risk

Result that strengthens model: Trend remains monotonic with quantified overprediction bands
